data.skills:
• Strong hands-on experience with optical systems and optical bench setups
• Practical experience handling lasers, detectors, optical alignment tools, and precision mounts
• Proficiency with optical measurement equipment and characterisation techniques
• Ability to perform microradian-level optical alignments
• Understanding of laser safety protocols and procedures
• Experience working collaboratively with electronics and mechanical engineers
• Self-motivated with the ability to own subsystems end-to-end

Preferred

• Experience with FSO communication, satellite systems, or ground stations
• Familiarity with optical design software (Zemax, CODE V, etc.)
• Knowledge of atmospheric turbulence effects and compensation techniques
• Experience with PAT (Pointing, Acquisition & Tracking) systems
• Programming skills in Python/MATLAB for automation and data analysis
• Exposure to high-speed optical modulation or FPGA-based signal processing
data.eligibility_information: Postgraduate degree (M.Sc/M.Tech/PhD) in Optics, Photonics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related field
data.additional_information: Join us in developing cutting-edge optical communication systems for space applications. You will work hands-on with lasers, telescopes, detectors, and precision alignment systems across various projects, including optical ground stations, satellite terminals, and emerging optical communication technologies. Your work will bridge laboratory prototypes and field-deployable hardware for terrestrial and space-based platforms.
data.additional_details:
What You'll Do

• Build, test and deploy free-space optical links (targeting 1-20 km ranges)
• Handle lasers, beam expanders, telescopes, filters and detectors with safe and precise procedures
• Perform microradian-level optical alignments for long-distance communication links
• Integrate and interface different optical subsystems
• Assemble and integrate optical systems with electronics and mechatronics teams
• Carry out tests and experiments to validate the performance of optical systems
• Support field experiments, PAT (Pointing, Acquisition & Tracking) alignment and on-site troubleshooting
• Characterise lasers, photodetectors, and complete link performance
• Document test procedures, experimental results and system specifications
